notes: Queries are read-only and parameterised. schedule_all.winner is expressed in schedule orientation; matches.winner is expressed relative to matches.team_a/team_b and is validated against the score in that same row. Do not compare winner side tokens across tables without mapping the named teams.

Q-MATCH-RESULT.description: Source schedule result for one series, in schedule team order.
Q-MATCH-RESULT.sql: select schedule_id, match_detail_id, team_a, team_b, score_a, score_b, winner, iso_date from schedule_all where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id
Q-MATCH-RESULT.provenance: source-reported schedule row; winner is in schedule orientation

Q-MATCH-DETAIL.description: Canonical matches row for one series, including its team orientation and MVP field.
Q-MATCH-DETAIL.sql: select match_detail_id, schedule_id, team_a, team_b, score_a, score_b, winner, iso_date, liq_mvp from matches where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id
Q-MATCH-DETAIL.provenance: source-reported detail row; matches.winner keeps schedule orientation and must not be read as the winner of matches.team_a/team_b

Q-GAMES.description: Per-game duration, winner, side and map mode for one series.
Q-GAMES.sql: select game_no, team_a, team_b, winner, duration_sec, team_a_side, team_b_side, map_mode from games where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id order by game_no
Q-GAMES.provenance: source-reported API detail; winner uses games.team_a/team_b orientation

Q-TEAM-GAMES.description: Per-team per-game scoreboard aggregates for one series.
Q-TEAM-GAMES.sql: select game_no, team, opponent, kills, deaths, assists, gold, tower_damage, duration_sec, win from team_games where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id order by game_no, team
Q-TEAM-GAMES.provenance: deterministic aggregate from ten player rows; not an official tournament table

Q-GAME-PICKS.description: Liquipedia lane-order picks for one series.
Q-GAME-PICKS.sql: select game_no, team, slot, lane, hero, player from game_picks where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id order by game_no, team, slot
Q-GAME-PICKS.provenance: Liquipedia draft slot order; slot is lane order, not pick order

Q-GAME-BANS.sql: select game_no, side, hero, ban_order from game_bans where match_detail_id = :match_detail_id order by game_no, side, ban_order
Q-GAME-BANS.provenance: Liquipedia ordered bans where available; two games have nine valid bans

Q-EVOS-PAQUITO-EUDORA.description: Counterexample sample: every EVOS game containing Paquito or Eudora, with result and tower damage.
Q-EVOS-PAQUITO-EUDORA.sql: select p.match_detail_id, p.game_no, p.hero, g.duration_sec, t.tower_damage, t.win from game_picks p join games g on g.match_detail_id = p.match_detail_id and g.game_no = p.game_no join team_games t on t.match_detail_id = p.match_detail_id and t.game_no = p.game_no and t.team = p.team where p.team = 'EVOS' and p.hero in ('Paquito','Eudora') order by p.match_detail_id, p.game_no, p.hero
Q-EVOS-PAQUITO-EUDORA.provenance: derived join; one row per hero per EVOS game

Q-CLOSE-GOLD-WINNERS.description: Counterexample sample: games with final gold difference under 3,000, including whether the winner had less tower damage.
Q-CLOSE-GOLD-WINNERS.sql: select match_detail_id, game_no, max(case when win=1 then team end) as winner, max(case when win=1 then gold end) as winner_gold, max(case when win=0 then gold end) as loser_gold, max(case when win=1 then tower_damage end) as winner_tower_damage, max(case when win=0 then tower_damage end) as loser_tower_damage, max(duration_sec) as duration_sec from team_games group by match_detail_id, game_no having abs(winner_gold - loser_gold) < 3000 order by abs(winner_gold - loser_gold), match_detail_id, game_no
Q-CLOSE-GOLD-WINNERS.provenance: derived from team_games; gold/tower values are scoreboard aggregates

Q-TLID-TOWER-GAMES.description: Counterexample sample: every TLID game with win, gold, tower damage and duration.
Q-TLID-TOWER-GAMES.sql: select match_detail_id, game_no, opponent, win, gold, tower_damage, duration_sec from team_games where team = 'TLID' order by match_detail_id, game_no
Q-TLID-TOWER-GAMES.provenance: derived from team_games; outcome field is the per-game win flag

Q-LINEAGE-WINNER-MISMATCH.description: Lineage audit: matches whose winner disagrees with the score in that row's team order. Should return zero rows after the guarded repair.
Q-LINEAGE-WINNER-MISMATCH.sql: select match_detail_id, team_a, team_b, score_a, score_b, winner from matches where (score_a > score_b and winner <> 'team_a') or (score_b > score_a and winner <> 'team_b') order by match_detail_id
Q-LINEAGE-WINNER-MISMATCH.provenance: derived consistency check; exposes orientation mismatch in matches.winner

Q-GAME-VOD-COVERAGE.description: Coverage of per-game YouTube VOD links.
Q-GAME-VOD-COVERAGE.sql: select count(*) as games, sum(case when vod_url is not null and trim(vod_url) <> '' then 1 else 0 end) as with_vod from games

Q-WINNER-INTEGRITY.description: Post-repair integrity count for matches.winner in each row's own team order.
Q-WINNER-INTEGRITY.sql: select count(*) as match_count, sum(case when CAST(score_a AS INTEGER)=CAST(score_b AS INTEGER) or winner <> CASE WHEN CAST(score_a AS INTEGER)>CAST(score_b AS INTEGER) THEN 'team_a' ELSE 'team_b' END then 1 else 0 end) as invalid_rows from matches
Q-WINNER-INTEGRITY.provenance: derived consistency check; 0 invalid rows is the migration gate
